quote.ml: സുപ്രഭാതം, ഈ ദിവസം നിങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിൽ പുതിയ പ്രതീക്ഷകൾ നൽകട്ടെ.
quote.en: Good morning, may this day bring new hope to your life.

quote.ml: ഓരോ പ്രഭാതവും പുതിയൊരു അവസരമാണ്, അത് സന്തോഷത്തോടെ സ്വീകരിക്കുക.
quote.en: Every morning is a new opportunity; accept it with joy.
Start your day with a smile.
May your today be even better than yesterday.

quote.ml: പുതിയ പ്രഭാതം, പുതിയ ആവേശം, പുതിയ തുടക്കം.
quote.en: New morning, new energy, new beginning.
Success comes to those who wake up before the sun.
A beautiful start to a beautiful morning.
May God's grace stay with you today.
May happiness be at your feet, Good Morning.
Something good is going to happen today.
If the mind is good, the world will be good.

quote.ml: പുതുമ നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു ദിവസം നിങ്ങൾക്കായി കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
quote.en: A day full of freshness is waiting for you.
Every day is a blessing.
Wake up with positive thoughts.
May the sunlight brighten your life.
Morning peace and all-day happiness.
Today is a step toward your dreams.
Good thoughts, good day.

quote.ml: വരൂ, ഇന്ന് നമുക്ക് പുതിയതായി എന്തെങ്കിലും പഠിക്കാം.
quote.en: Let's learn something new today.
May your smile give courage to everyone.

quote.ml: പകൽ മുഴുവൻ അധ്വാനിച്ച തളർച്ച മറന്ന് സമാധാനമായി ഉറങ്ങുക.
quote.en: Forget the day's fatigue and sleep peacefully.
May the stars guard your sleep.

quote.ml: നാളെ ഒരു പുതിയ പ്രഭാതം നിങ്ങൾക്കായി കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നു.
quote.en: A new morning will be waiting for you tomorrow.
Fall asleep with sweet dreams.

quote.ml: ചന്ദ്രന്റെ കുളിർമ നിങ്ങളുടെ മനസ്സിന് ശാന്തി നൽകട്ടെ.
quote.en: May the coolness of the moon bring peace to your mind.
Forget today's mistakes and sleep well.
Find solace in the silence of the night.
May God give you protection and peace.
Time to get lost in the world of dreams.

quote.ml: ശുഭരാത്രി, നാളെ വീണ്ടും പുതിയ ആവേശത്തോടെ കാണാം.
quote.en: Good night, let's meet again tomorrow with new energy.
When sleep comes, all sorrows rest.
The darkness will pass, the light will surely come.
Forgive everyone before you sleep.
Take rest, for you must fight again tomorrow.
May your pillow be as soft as clouds.
The night is deep, but hope still remains.
Peaceful sleep is the greatest wealth.

quote.ml: നക്ഷത്രങ്ങൾ നിറഞ്ഞ രാത്രി മനസ്സിന് ശാന്തി നൽകട്ടെ.
quote.en: May the starry night bring peace to your soul.
Everything is safe in the embrace of sleep.
Tomorrow's sun will bring new joys.

quote.ml: നീ എന്റെ ജീവിതത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും മനോഹരമായ ഭാഗമാണ്.
quote.en: You are the most beautiful part of my life.
A heart drowned in love remembers only you.
My whole world is in your eyes.
Love isn't what is shown, but what is kept.

quote.ml: എന്റെ ഓരോ ദിവസവും നിന്റെ ഓർമ്മകളാൽ തുടങ്ങുന്നു.
quote.en: My every day begins with your memories.
If you are with me, every destination is easy.
Love is a form of worship.

quote.ml: നിന്റെ ഒരു പുഞ്ചിരി എന്റെ ദിവസം മാറ്റുന്നു.
quote.en: Your one smile makes my day.
The meeting of souls is true love.

quote.ml: നീ യാഥാർത്ഥ്യമാണോ അതോ ഒരു സുന്ദര സ്വപ്നമാണോ?
quote.en: Are you reality or a beautiful dream?
My heart beats only for you.
True love never ends.
You are my first and last desire.
Bowing in love is not a bad thing.
This life is incomplete without you.
Love is the greatest strength.
My heartbeat and your memories.
Starts with you and ends with you.
Love has no religion.

quote.ml: നീ കൂടെയുണ്ടായാൽ മതി, ലോകത്തെ മുഴുവൻ ഞാൻ ജയിക്കും.
quote.en: Just stay with me, and we will win the world.
Real peace is only at the feet of the Lord.
Whatever happens is God's will.
There is strength in devotion.
Chant the Lord's name; your worries will end.
Faith and patience are the pillars of life.
God resides in every atom.
You are the doer, You are the creator.
Do not leave the Lord's side even in adversity.
Work is worship.
Shiva alone is the truth.
Chanting God's name calms the mind.
True faith is that which is unbreakable.
All fears vanish in the shelter of the Lord.
Morning prayer, purification of the soul.
Whatever God does, He does for our best.

quote.ml: നിന്റെ ഉള്ളിൽ തിരയുക, അവിടെ ദൈവത്തെ കാണാം.
quote.en: Look within your heart; you will find God there.
Jai Shri Ram, the foundation of life.
Without God, not even a leaf moves.
Devotion is the thread that connects us to God.
God's grace is boundless.
You haven't lost until you stop trying.
Destinations are reached by those with life in their dreams.
Difficulties come only to hardworking people.
Today's hard work is tomorrow's peace.
Believe in yourself, and the world will be yours.
There is no shortcut to success.
Those who try never fail.
Time changes; just keep working hard.
Think big, grow high.
Your struggle is your story.
Accept the challenges.
You must have the fire to achieve your goal.
Don't fear the dark; that's where the stars shine.

quote.ml: ഓരോ ചെറിയ മാറ്റവും വലിയ വിജയത്തിന്റെ തുടക്കമാണ്.
quote.en: Every small change is a foundation for big success.
Don't stop; there is a long way to go.
Your work will speak for itself.
Write your own destiny.
Courage is the greatest weapon.
Don't lose today in worry for tomorrow.
Victory is certain if the resolve is firm.
The glow of festivals, the love of loved ones.

quote.ml: ഈ ഉത്സവം നിങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിൽ സന്തോഷം നിറയ്ക്കട്ടെ.
quote.en: May this festival bring joy to your life.
The festival of sweetness and light.
This day has brought a gift of happiness.
Happy victory of good over evil.
A confluence of colors and excitement.
Festivals bring us together.

quote.ml: ഓരോ വീട്ടിലും വിളക്ക് തെളിയട്ടെ, മനസ്സ് സന്തോഷിക്കട്ടെ.
quote.en: May every home light a lamp, every heart be happy.
Respect for traditions, a festival of joy.
May this festival bring sweetness to relationships.
New year, new hopes.
Celebrate every festival with great enthusiasm.
Congratulations on the shower of happiness.
A festival that teaches love and peace.
May all your wishes come true this festival.
Decorate the house; the festival is here.
Our festivals are a testament to unity in diversity.
Share happiness, celebrate the festival.
Hearty greetings for the festival.
May prosperity grow on this holy day.
Family is the greatest strength in the world.
Home is where the heart is.
Parents' blessings are the true wealth.
Staying together is the identity of a family.
Life is incomplete without family.
Happy family, beautiful life.
Respect for elders, love for youngsters.
Only family helps in times of crisis.
Learn to value relationships.
The foundation of values begins with family.
My family, my life.
Supporting each other is the soul of a family.

quote.ml: ലോകത്തിന് നിങ്ങൾ ഒരാൾ മാത്രമായിരിക്കാം, പക്ഷെ കുടുംബത്തിന് നിങ്ങൾ ഒരു ലോകമാണ്.
quote.en: To the world you are one person, to your family you are the world.
The peace of the house is in the mother's smile.

quote.ml: അച്ഛന്റെ വിരൽ തുമ്പിൽ പിടിച്ചു നടക്കുകയാണ് സുരക്ഷിതം.
quote.en: Walking while holding a father's finger is security.
The love between siblings is eternal.
Family's company is like heaven.
Arguments should be small; love should be big.
Time spent with family is priceless.
True happiness is with the family.
The movie isn't over yet, my friend!

quote.ml: ജീവിതം ഒരു സിനിമയാണ്, നിന്റെ വേഷം നന്നായി ചെയ്യുക.
quote.en: Life is a movie; just play your role well.

quote.ml: ജയിക്കുന്നവൻ മാത്രമല്ല ഹീറോ, മനസ്സ് ജയിക്കുന്നവനാണ് ഹീറോ.
quote.en: A hero isn't the one who wins, but the one who wins hearts.
Dialogues are just words; the real life is in acting.
What appears on screen is the result of hard work.
Cinema is a world of dreams.
Every common man is the hero of his own story.
It's the twist in the story that makes it interesting.
Emotions matter more than action.
The echo of applause is the biggest award.
Cinema is the mirror of society.
A good film can change a life.
A superstar is one who stays grounded.
The magical world of cinema.
Art has no end.
Cinema teaches us how to live.
Every shot has a new story.
Background music is what makes the moment special.
Salute to the hard work behind the scenes.
The shine of the film world, the salt of hard work.
The sacrifice of heroes will not go in vain.
My country is my religion.
Heroes never die; they become immortal.
The tricolor is my pride.
The price of freedom was paid with the blood of heroes.
Dying for the motherland is the ultimate glory.
Indomitable courage is the identity of heroes.
Hail the soldier, hail the farmer.
History is witness: bravery never bows down.
The protectors of the nation are the real heroes.
Sacrifice never goes in vain.
Victory to Mother India!
Discipline and bravery are the mantras of life.
A roar so fierce that even the enemy trembles.
Freedom is my birthright.
The nation comes first.
In unity lies strength.
There is no love greater than love for the country.
Land of heroes, nation of heroes.
Salute to those heroes who gave their lives for the country.
Pain hidden in words is called poetry.
The pen speaks when the heart is silent.
Poetry is the voice of emotions.
Poetry is the mirror of the heart.
Play of words, confluence of feelings.
A story is hidden in every poem.
Sweetness of Ghazal, thirst of the soul.
A poet is one who says everything without saying it.
Loneliness poured onto paper.
Weaving dreams into words is poetry.
Simplicity is the greatest beauty.
Incomplete stories often become poetry.
Words are both ointment and wounds.
The pen is mightier than the sword.

quote.ml: കവിത ഒരു വിനോദം മാത്രമല്ല, അതൊരു സമാധാനമാണ്.
quote.en: Poetry is not just a hobby; it is peace.
Heart's feelings, on paper.
Poetry is a ray of light in the darkness.
Two lines, a thousand meanings.
Poetic style, the secret of life.
To write is to live.
Friendship is that which is beyond words.

quote.ml: ഒരു നല്ല സുഹൃത്ത് ആയിരം ബന്ധുക്കൾക്ക് തുല്യമാണ്.
quote.en: A true friend is better than a thousand relatives.
In friendship, no one is big or small.
Walking together is friendship.
The bond of friendship is the holiest.
Friendship is my faith.
A friend is one who helps in times of trouble.
Understanding heart's feelings without words is friendship.

quote.ml: ആയിരം സുഹൃത്തുക്കൾ ഉള്ളതിനേക്കാൾ, ആപത്തിൽ കൂടെ നിൽക്കുന്ന ഒരാൾ ഉള്ളതാണ് ഭാഗ്യം.
quote.en: Having thousands of friends is not big; having one who stands by in trouble is big.
Status is not looked at in friendship.

quote.ml: പഴയ ഓർമ്മകളും നല്ല സുഹൃത്തുക്കളും എന്നും കൂടെയുണ്ടാകും.
quote.en: Old memories and true friends always stay together.
Not a friend, he is my brother.
Friendship has no expiry date.
Laughter, fun, and lots of memories.
Friendship makes life beautiful.
Relationships should be of heart, not blood.
True friendship never ends.
Every journey is a lesson with a friend.
Lucky are those who have true friends.
Friendship is a gift that everyone doesn't get.
Many many happy returns of the day!
May this year be full of happiness for you.
May success kiss your feet.
May you live thousands of years with health.
Get the gift of happiness on your birthday.
Keep smiling always; that's our prayer.
A party is a must!
Happy new year and new beginning.
May every wish of yours come true.
Progress a lot and be happy.
Birthday cake and lots of love.
May there be a shower of happiness today.
Happy one more year of wisdom.
Laughter, joy, and lots of gifts.
Happy Birthday, my friend.

quote.ml: പ്രായം വെറും സംഖ്യയാണ്, ആവേശം എന്നും കുറയരുത്.
quote.en: Age is just a number; the passion should be the same.
Today is only your day.
May you get health, happiness, and prosperity.
There is no one like you.
Hearty congratulations on your birthday.
